meta.source: Mundt, Marks, Shear & Greist (2002), Br J Psychiatry 180:461–464 — English original

questionnaires.title: Work and Social Adjustment Scale (WSAS)
questionnaires.description: A 5-item measure of functional impairment in work, home management, social leisure, private leisure and relationships. Scores range 0–40; higher scores indicate more severe impairment.

items.text: People’s problems sometimes affect their ability to do certain day-to-day tasks in their lives. For each section below, rate how much your problem impairs your ability to carry out the activity.
Because of my problem, my ability to work is impaired.
Because of my problem, my home management (cleaning, tidying, shopping, cooking, looking after home or children, paying bills) is impaired.
Because of my problem, my social leisure activities (with other people, such as parties, bars, clubs, outings, visits, dating, home entertainment) are impaired.
Because of my problem, my private leisure activities (done alone, such as reading, gardening, collecting, sewing, walking alone) are impaired.
Because of my problem, my ability to form and maintain close relationships with others, including those I live with, is impaired.
